[b][font=sans-serif][color=#6aa84f]A very lore-friendly redraw of Alecto. [/color]

I aimed to keep the style from the original mod, cause of 
the already incredible depiction of her. 
I did change the color of her eyes tho due to my own storyline that I'm writing to match the RRRR lore. 

Just to be clear: THIS IS JUST AN ART REPLACER!

Apart from the Portraits I had to change the Color of the sprite's eyes.[/font][/b][/size][/center]
